summary: LiqTech International issued $1.1M principal of 9.09% original discount promissory notes to affiliates of Bleichroeder L.P. and Laurence W. Lytton for $1M cash. The two-month notes bear no interest before maturity; thereafter, interest accrues at 10% p.a. increasing monthly to a 16% cap. Proceeds fund working capital. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
